title: Radiotherapy plan optimization: CORT phantom pilot
summary: Research-only synthetic-phantom benchmark for dose sparing with discrete beam selection, independent numerical evaluation and explicit delivery-model limitations.

credit.policy: Credit implementation, verification, negative results and literature work in CONTRIBUTORS.md; disclose agent assistance. Authorship by substantial scientific contribution, not compute alone.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

requirements.note: Python binary wheels; requirements.lock records the tested environment. Other Python/platform combinations are not yet verified.
